logistics: Luggage, Dec 15–18: everything comes from Haneda to Ninja House (Toshima).

Luggage, Fri 18 Dec: send the big suitcases with Yamato TA-Q-BIN (konbini or front desk) to Kujō House for Mon 21 evening delivery (confirm the host can receive them; otherwise send to a Yamato centre near Kujō). Take only overnight bags to Hakone on Dec 19.
Luggage, Hakone Dec 19–21: overnight bags only; they ride along to Gotemba and the Shinkansen on Dec 21.

Luggage, Fri 25 Dec: send suitcases from Kujō House to Garfield House (Shinjuku) for Sat 26 evening delivery (confirm the host can receive them), or carry them on the Shinkansen with an oversized-luggage seat reservation.

Luggage, Sun 27 Dec → Tue 29 Dec: send the big suitcases from Garfield House to Haneda T3 with Yamato airport delivery on Dec 27 and collect them at the T3 counter on Dec 29; check out by 10:00 with day bags only. Tax-free goods and receipts stay in the carry-on for the customs kiosk, before bag drop.

Passes: an IC card each (Suica/PASMO, works in Osaka too) for city trains and buses. Hakone Freepass from Shinjuku covers Odakyu one way plus the Hakone trains, cable car, ropeway, pirate ship and most buses for Dec 19–21; Romancecar seats are extra. Osaka: IC card plus single-company day passes only when a day uses them a lot. Kamakura/Enoshima: the Odakyu Enoshima-Kamakura Freepass from Shinjuku. Shinkansen Mishima→Shin-Osaka (Dec 21) and Shin-Osaka→Tokyo (Dec 26): reserve seats for all 8 together in advance.

Tax-free (since 1 Nov 2026): pay the full price with your own passport at the till; the tax is refunded at departure after customs checks the goods at Haneda T3 (customs kiosk before bag drop). Keep tax-free goods unused, with their receipts, in your carry-on. Purchases can't be pooled between people.
ID and drinking: the drinking and club age is 20+; clubs and Round1 check the ORIGINAL passport at night.

Year-end: Christmas markets and illuminations end Dec 25. From about Dec 28 some small shops, museums and gardens close; chains, clubs, karaoke and Round1 run normally through Dec 28. Dec 29 is a peak travel day.
Trains stop around 00:30; after that it's taxis (2 cars for 8) or the first train around 05:00.

days.start: Land Haneda T3 15:00; out of arrivals about 16:15
days.notes: Keikyu/monorail + Yamanote to Ikebukuro. Dinner and first night around Ikebukuro East/West exits (Mutekiya, AYCE yakiniku, Daitokai, Round1 Ikebukuro 24h). Keep it local: jet lag.

days.theme: Boro-ichi flea market, vintage, Shibuya Sky sunset, Shibuya night
anchors: Setagaya Boro-ichi (15–16 Dec only), go early
days.notes: Shimokitazawa vintage opens ~12:00. Shibuya night: Shibuya Yokocho / Ebisu Yokocho, karaoke.

days.theme: East side: market breakfast, teamLab, Asakusa Hagoita-ichi at dusk, monja dinner
days.notes: Tsukiji outer market breakfast (Thu is fine). teamLab Planets timed slot. Shin-Toyosu Christmas market nearby. Night back toward Ikebukuro or Ueno.

days.theme: Anime and sneakers, Ameyoko, Christmas markets, ZEROTOKYO big night
anchors: Roppongi Hills Christmas market + Keyakizaka lights
days.notes: Akihabara (Mandarake, Super Potato, Radio Kaikan) + Ueno Ameyoko in the day. Send suitcases to Osaka today (TA-Q-BIN). Biggest bōnenkai night: book any sit-down dinner for 8. Hakone departure tomorrow morning.

days.theme: Romancecar, onsen, Open-Air Museum, geisha night
anchors: Check in Hot Spring Hakone Villa from 15:00
Hakone Yumoto Kenban geisha night if on Sat 19 (3rd Saturday, book)
days.notes: Hakone Freepass starts today. Yumoto: soba, shopping street, day onsen; Open-Air Museum; Gora. Taxi cap ¥4,000 pp.

days.theme: Ropeway, pirate ship, torii, lights, onsen
anchors: Ropeway Togendai ⇄ Owakudani (Sōunzan section closed 7–24 Dec, replacement bus)
days.notes: Hakone Shrine torii, Gora (Open-Air Museum if not day 5, Gora Brewery), Glass no Mori Christmas illumination, dinner near Sengokuhara. Taxi cap ¥4,000 pp.

days.theme: Outlet haul, Shinkansen to Osaka, first Osaka night
days.start: Check out Hot Spring Hakone Villa by 10:00
days.notes: Suitcases arrive at Kujō this evening. First Osaka night: Tenma crawl or Dotonbori/Ura-Namba; Kinryu ramen 24h.

days.theme: Universal Studios Japan winter + Minami night
anchors: Universal Studios Japan all day (tickets + Express Pass bought ahead)
days.notes: Kujō → Nishikujō → JR Yumesaki line. Night: Dotonbori / Round1 Sennichimae if energy remains.

days.area: Kyoto: Fushimi Inari · Higashiyama · Gion · Nishiki · Pontocho
days.theme: Kyoto east day into Kyoto night
days.notes: Kiyomizu/Higashiyama by ~08:30, Gion midday, Nishiki market lunch, Shinkyogoku/Teramachi last 60–90 min of shopping, Pontocho at dusk, Kiyamachi bars, Hankyu or Keihan back.

days.area: Nara · Minami (Den Den Town, Shinsaibashi, Amemura) · Nakanoshima
days.theme: Christmas Eve: Nara deer morning, Minami shopping, Hikari Renaissance lights, club night
anchors: Nara Park + Todai-ji (Hanshin/Kintetsu direct from Kujō)
Hikari Renaissance (ends 25 Dec) + Midosuji illumination walk
days.notes: Yaekatsu is closed Thursdays. Christmas Eve: book dinner for 8.

days.theme: Christmas Day: kushikatsu, okonomiyaki, Umeda, biggest party night
anchors: Shinsekai: Yaekatsu or Daruma kushikatsu, Tsutenkaku
days.notes: Send suitcases to Garfield House today. Umeda Sky Christmas ends today. Night: Ura-Namba crawl → club (Giraffe/Circus) → Round1 Sennichimae karaoke till first train. Book dinner for 8.

days.theme: Shinkansen back, Rainbow fireworks, Shinjuku night
days.notes: Lunch on the way (ekiben or Tokyo). Night: Omoide Yokocho, Kabuki Hall (8 walk-in), ZEROTOKYO, Nagi ramen 24h.

anchors: Kamakura Great Buddha + Enoshima (Odakyu Enoshima-Kamakura Freepass)
Tokyo Metropolitan Government observatory (free, open 26/27 Dec)
days.notes: Tsukiji is shut Sun 27. Night: Umi no Ie nomihodai, Golden Gai in fours, karaoke.

days.theme: Vintage and streetwear, last big night
anchors: Harajuku Takeshita → Ura-Hara → Cat Street → Shibuya
days.notes: Last safe night before year-end closures: ATOM Shibuya or Kabukicho karaoke. Shibuya MEGA Donki late.

days.theme: Last breakfast, last shopping, fly home
anchors: At Haneda T3 by 14:00: customs kiosk for the tax-free refund before bag drop
days.notes: Breakfast Shinpachi Shokudo. Last Shinjuku shopping (Don Quijote, Bic Camera) only near the station. Eat at Haneda T3 Edo Koji before security.
